name: Crushing Pressure, Mass Lesser
body:
School transmutation; Level inquisitor 5, magus 5, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5, witch 5

EFFECT

Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 15)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lesser crushing pressure except it affects multiple targets.
